economic_absence.how_the_version_was_resolved: provenance.design PAIR {path, sha256}, digest recomputed from THE PATH THE RECEIPT NAMES
economic_absence.not_to_be_confused_with: `emitted_census.n_leaves_emitted`, which walks THIS RECORD -- the anti-echo control on what this seat itself publishes
economic_absence.the_rule: A SEALED NAME PRESENT AS A KEY REFUSES, WHATEVER ITS VALUE -- including an empty container and null. ABSENCE IS THE ONLY SEAL.

version_evidence.resolution: the path the receipt NAMES, resolved against the canonical code root

economic_absence.walks: THE RECEIPT under test, BY KEY
economic_absence.why_by_key: a leaf walk never reaches an empty container, so a sealed name emitted as `[]` or `{}` was PRESENT AND IGNORED -- the one state the receipt's own seal_status says cannot happen. Absence is the only seal
economic_absence.why_paths_only: a leak is reported BY NAME. Echoing the value would publish the number the seal exists to withhold, which is the failure this check exists to prevent -- not a lesser one
economic_absence.why_scoped: a receipt is judged by the list in force WHEN IT WAS PRODUCED; a name sealed later did not exist as a rule for it. An unresolvable version is judged against every name -- absence never selects the weaker rule

emitted_census.PATHS_ONLY: this census names the PATH in THIS record where a collision sits, never which sealed field matched and never the value -- naming the sealed field would publish the association the seal exists to withhold

allowlisted_because: the declaration VERSION NUMBERS present on disk -- a version is not a quantity of any day

the_declared_rule.head: da_anti_echo_v1.json
the_declared_rule.integer_rule: AN EXACT EQUALITY REFUSES AT ANY DIGIT COUNT
the_declared_rule.reporting_property: PATHS ONLY. The census reports the PATH in THIS record where a collision sits and NEVER which sealed field matched, and never the value.

emitted_census.values_are_never_reproduced_here: a hit is reported by PATH and by HOW. Printing the value would publish what the seal withholds, in the very field that exists to prevent it
emitted_census.why_a_coincidence_is_not_an_echo: since R-659 the sealed list carries three OUTCOME COUNTS, which are small integers; one of this record's own structural counters equalling one of them identifies nothing. The same precision standard the prose scan declares applies to numeric leaves, and the collision is REPORTED BY PATH rather than dropped
emitted_census.why_declared_thresholds_are_excluded: 0.25, 30, 500 and the rest are public BY DECLARATION and appear in honest prose everywhere. Watching them made this census refuse its own correct output on the first attempt
emitted_census.why_the_prose_matters: a SEALED receipt has no economic numeric leaves, so a watch list built from them alone is EMPTY -- and a number hidden in prose has nothing to be compared against. The census could then only catch a leak in a receipt that had already leaked, which is no catch at all
emitted_census.why_three_checks: a name check alone passes while the NUMBER rides out under a different key; a leaf check alone passes while the number rides out INSIDE A STRING -- REV 49 section 2.4, and the exact class DE 85 found. The third check reads the prose, as WHOLE TOKENS: matching textual forms as raw substrings flagged this verifier's own honest output, because '3.2' sits inside '63.21'

exit_code_meaning.why: the four-state scheme this seat already uses (DA 71)

conjuncts.conjunct: each day's sealed receipt digest equals the one DA's pre-read recorded WHEN THE DAY LANDED; a re-run after landing REFUSES -- waiting must not become re-rolling. A superseding vN is admitted only when its chain reaches the landed digest
conjuncts.the_digest_is_the_CHAIN_HEADS: REV 51 (a): a superseded receipt's landing digest is the digest of the chain HEAD, because the head is what a read would use. A v1 whose v2 supersedes it is not the artifact under test

conjuncts.conjunct: each day has >= 1 arm with admissibility.admissible true, read from the SEALED artifact. Six all-inadmissible days satisfy existence and contribute ZERO SIGNS
day_quality_pass AND era_pure AND counts_toward_race -- R-555's membership. A sealed receipt is DE's own artifact and is not a day verdict
conjuncts.why: the ledger's own day verdict, one per ruled day

conjuncts.conjunct: producing_code_sha256 equals the runner's blob at the receipt's carrying_commit. For 2026-09-03 the .v2 supersession is what makes this hold: v1 was stamped from a file replaced mid-run (R-603)

THE_FALLBACK_OUTCOME_IF_IT_PASSES.NEVER_APPLIED_SILENTLY: past the horizon the declared fallback is G = 5, DIRECTIONAL -- a different claim from the six-day test, and this verifier NAMES it rather than quietly reading the smaller G as though it were the ruled one. Whether to take the fallback is the coordinator's act

conjuncts.conjunct: if the sixth ruled day has not landed by horizon_utc the read opens at G = 5 over the five LANDED ruled days, DIRECTIONAL ONLY (2^-5 = 0.03125 is not significant at m = 2), with the sixth disclosed as UNBUILT
a params file lacking this list REFUSES before any day is examined. DA's gate reads the SAME field; two implementations of one bar must not disagree silently
conjuncts.why: the conjunction was read from `read_gate.the_bar_is_a_CONJUNCTION` -- had it been absent this predicate would have REFUSED before any conjunct was evaluated, so reaching here IS the conjunct holding

predicate.why_unevaluable_is_not_a_pass: a conjunct no evaluator matches is reported and CLOSES the gate. Params growing from two conjuncts to eight cannot widen what this verifier silently accepts

gate_state_recorded_not_enforced.the_bar_is_a_CONJUNCTION_not_a_clock: R-604. Reading `read_not_before_utc` alone would open on a bar weaker than the one DE declares

incomplete_because: the population half was REFUSED BY NAME and NOT ATTEMPTED: BOOK_IS_A_PICKLE_NOT_THIS_READER'S_JSON

landing_digest_fields.equality_is_asserted: at write time, and again at every read
landing_digest_fields.what_DEs_design_must_name: the same field. Until DE's design names one, this is DA's declaration alone and says so
landing_digest_fields.why_the_authority_is_that_one: DE's `landing_record_for` reads `receipt.sha256`; this seat used to read only its own `landing_record.receipt_sha256`. Two copies written by two calls agree until they do not, and the conjunct that stops a re-roll resolves through the copy nobody was checking (REV 54 section 1.3)

landing_record.what_it_is_for: the read gate's `sealed receipts at their LANDING digests` conjunct compares the receipt on disk against THIS digest. A receipt re-emitted after the pre-read moves the digest and the conjunct fails by name

landing_record_naming.clock_token: a UTC stamp %Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ, read from a clock
landing_record_naming.correction_path: in band as `.v2`, carrying supersedes = {path, sha256} of the record it replaces (R-608's PAIR). A chained pair resolves to the v2; two UNCHAINED records for one day are AMBIGUOUS and the landing conjunct refuses rather than picking one
landing_record_naming.day_comes_from: the artifact's `day` FIELD, never the filename
landing_record_naming.why_declared: REV 52 section 2.4: an artifact this verifier's own read gate depends on had no declared name and no correction path, so a mistaken pre-read could not be superseded -- only shadowed

peak_rss_note: ru_maxrss of THIS process, which is where BE 66 measured 2.079 GB for the open; systemd's MemoryPeak is the cgroup's and is reported beside it, not instead of it

design.resolution: the path the receipt NAMES, resolved against the canonical code root
design.why: the digest of the file the receipt NAMES, against the digest the receipt DECLARES -- not against a version hardcoded in the verifier

params_named_by_the_receipt.why: the digest of the params file the RECEIPT names, against the digest the receipt declares -- not against a constant here and not against whatever is newest

runner_economic_field_list.read_by: ast, at the source; not imported and not copied

the_halves_this_status_is_computed_from.why: a status computed from ONE counter says nothing when that counter is not the one that ran; each half states itself and the status is a function of the three

the_open_book_contract.digest_pinned_to: the receipt's own book digest, verified before any open
the_open_book_contract.order: digest-pinned to BE's receipt BEFORE the open (a mismatch refuses without opening); the open only under the heavy lock and the 8 GiB cap in the service form; and the record states that this reader EXECUTED another seat's serialisation
the_open_book_contract.rule_20: the heavy lock and the 8 GiB cap, in the service form -- this run did not open a book
the_open_book_contract.what_opening_a_book_is: `pickle.load` runs the opcodes in the file: opening a book is EXECUTING BYTES ANOTHER SEAT WROTE, and no check that runs afterwards can undo it. The only control before that point is the DIGEST, which is why it is pinned first and why a mismatch never reaches the open

the_run_that_produced_this.read_at: THE END OF THE RUN, from inside the run
the_run_that_produced_this.why_here: a Q-row is prose; the id belongs in the artifact's own bytes so a reader resolves the run without a person
the_run_that_produced_this.why_not_the_property: systemd's MemoryPeak property read after the unit exits is NOT the run's peak -- BE 74 measured 2,578,067,456 at the leaf against 847,671,296 at the property for one run. Both are reported, each with its source

why_committed_bytes_is_reported_not_gati: the durable citation is the verifier's CONTENT DIGEST, carried here either way; a commit id can be rewritten by a rebase and a worktree's HEAD is whatever it was last detached at. The flag is in front of the reader rather than folded silently into a verdict
why_first_of_family: this is the pre-read of a NEW receipt head. A pre-read is ABOUT one receipt; when the receipt is superseded the new head is a different artifact, so its pre-read starts its own family rather than correcting the record of the receipt it replaced -- that record stays true of the receipt it read
why_n_arms_agreeing_is_none: no population was recomputed, so no arm was compared. 0 would read as two arms DISAGREEING
why_never_a_verification_of_the_economic: this mode reads no economic field and computes no economic quantity. It is a verification of the POPULATION, the SEED, the STATUSES and the PROVENANCE, and saying so is the point: a pre-read reported as a verification would be the sealed-receipt error in a new place
why_no_bar_here: the bar schedules the READ of the economics. This mode reads none, before or after it -- the two gates are independent and this is on the far side of neither
why_that_is_structural: decisions and per-side counts are arithmetic on the book's own scores against the declared thetas. D(E0), the null and everything downstream need the replay, and this path never resolves one -- so it cannot compute an economic value, let alone emit it
why_the_population_was_not_recomputed: REFUSED: BOOK_IS_A_PICKLE_NOT_THIS_READER'S_JSON -- be_daybook_20260906_btc.pkl is BE's pickled day book (275035656 bytes). This reader consumes `rows` + `scores_by_arm`; the pickle carries `asm.by_arm` and `fr`. The population half of the pre-read CANNOT be recomputed until that mapping is read from BE's declaration, and opening the pickle is ~2 GB, which is HEAVY under rule 20 and cannot ride in a light run.
why_this_status: FLAGGED is reserved for a flag IN THE DAY -- an arm COMPARED and disagreeing, a DECLARED digest its file does not have, or a seal that leaked. A clean seal beside an unevaluated half and a missing provenance INPUT is INCOMPLETE, and a reader must be able to tell those apart (REV 70 section 2)
